这一讲把第 00 讲的直觉正式化: 先定义双射, 再用双射定义「两个集合一样大」, 最后严格证明康托尔定理. 重点是康托尔定理证明里的对角集合 D 和「任取函数、证它不是满射」的思路.

双射
Bijections

Slide 6–8

Injections and Surjections

  • An injective function associates at most one element of the domain with each element of the codomain.
  • A surjective function associates at least one element of the domain with each element of the codomain.
  • New! A bijective function associates exactly one element of the domain with each element of the codomain.

Bijections

  • A bijection is a function that is both injective and surjective.
  • Intuitively, if f:A→B is a bijection, then f represents a way of pairing elements of A with elements of B.

从陪域的角度看三类函数: 单射让陪域每个元素至多被一个输入对应; 满射让每个元素至少被一个输入对应; bijection 双射让每个元素恰好被一个输入对应. 所以双射就是既单又满的函数.

直觉上, 双射就是 A 与 B 元素之间的一种一一配对, 正是第 00 讲比较集合大小时用的「配对」.

重谈基数
Cardinality Revisited

Slide 10–12

Cardinality

  • Recall (from our first lecture!) that the cardinality of a set is the number of elements it contains.
  • If S is a set, we denote its cardinality by ∣S∣.

Comparing Cardinality

  • Saying two finite sets are equal relies on a definition of “equal” for integers.

    ∣{1,2}∣=2=2=∣{3,6}∣ is true, because = is defined for integers

  • Defining “equal” for infinite set cardinality can't rely on the integer “=” operator, because infinite values are not integers.
  • Intuition: Two sets have the same cardinality if there's a way to pair off their elements.

Comparing Cardinalities

  • Here is the formal definition of what it means for two sets to have the same cardinality:

    ∣S∣=∣T∣ if there exists a bijection f:S→T

有限集比较大小时, 我们其实是先各数出一个整数, 再用整数的等号比较: ∣{1,2}∣=2, ∣{3,6}∣=2, 2 = 2. 无限集的「大小」不是整数, 不能这样比. 所以要单独给「基数相等」下定义:

∣S∣=∣T∣ 当且仅当存在一个双射 f:S→T.

注意这是一个新定义的「=」, 只是借用了等号的写法.

Slide 14–15

The f shown at right is not bijective. Does this mean that the sets have unequal cardinality?

Yay, bijective!

课堂提问: 图中这个 f 不是双射, 能说明两个集合大小不同吗? 不能. 定义说的是「存在一个双射」, 一个具体的 f 失败了, 也许别的函数能成功. 第二张图就换了一种连法, 是双射, 所以两个集合一样大.

易错: 要证 ∣S∣=∣T∣, 必须证明所有从 S 到 T 的函数都不是双射, 而不是只举一个反例. 康托尔定理的证明正是这样做的.

基数的趣题
Fun with Cardinality

Slide 17–19

Terminology Refresher

  • Let a and b be real numbers where a≤b.
  • The notation [a,b] denotes the set of all real numbers between a and b, inclusive.

    [a,b]={x∈R∣a≤x≤b}

  • The notation (a,b) denotes the set of all real numbers between a and b, exclusive.

    (a,b)={x∈R∣a<x<b}

Consider the sets [0,1] and [0,2]. How do their cardinalities compare?

记号: [a,b] 是闭区间 (含端点), (a,b) 是开区间 (不含端点).

[0, 1] 和 [0, 2] 哪个大? 直觉说后者长一倍. 但长度不是基数. 图里像投影仪一样, 从一点发出射线, 把短线段上的点一一投到长线段上: f(x) = 2x. 每个点恰好对应一个点, 所以二者一样大.

Slide 20–44

Theorem: ∣[0,1]∣=∣[0,2]∣

Proof: Consider the function f:[0,1]→[0,2] defined as f(x)=2x. We will prove that f is a bijection.

First, we will show that f is a well-defined function. Choose any x∈[0,1]. This means that 0≤x≤1, so we know that 0≤2x≤2. Consequently, we see that 0≤f(x)≤2, so f(x)∈[0,2].

Next, we'll show that f is injective. Pick any x1​,x2​∈[0,1] where f(x1​)=f(x2​). We will show that x1​=x2​. To see this, notice that since f(x1​)=f(x2​), we see that 2x1​=2x2​, which in turn tells us that x1​=x2​, as required.

Finally, we will show that f is surjective. To do so, consider any y∈[0,2]. We'll show that there is some x∈[0,1] where f(x)=y.

Let x=y/2. Since y∈[0,2], we know 0≤y≤2, and therefore that 0≤y/2≤1. We picked x=y/2, so we know that 0≤x≤1, which in turn means x∈[0,1]. Moreover, notice that f(x)=2x=2(y/2)=y, so f(x)=y, as required. ■

证明 ∣S∣=∣T∣ 的标准套路: 给出一个具体的函数, 证它是双射. 这里分三部分:

  1. 是良定义的函数: 输入在 [0, 1] 时输出确实落在 [0, 2]. 若陪域写错 (比如写成 [0, 1]), 这一步就过不了.
  2. 单射: 用「像相同则原像相同」, 解方程即可.
  3. 满射: 任取 y, 取 x = y/2, 还要检查这个 x 确实在定义域 [0, 1] 里, 然后验证 f(x) = y.

课堂练习: 单射部分的 Assume 是「任取 x1​,x2​∈[0,1] 且 f(x1​)=f(x2​)」, WTS 是「x1​=x2​」.

为什么不证确定性: 课件说, 惯例是证函数满足定义域/陪域规则, 但没有证确定性的惯例. 公式定义的函数天然是确定的.

Slide 45–47

Some Properties of Cardinality (Take these as given from now on)

Theorem: For any set A, we have ∣A∣=∣A∣.

Proof: Consider any set A, and let f:A→A be the function defined as f(x)=x. We will prove that f is a bijection.

First, we'll show that f is a well-defined function. To see this, note that for any x∈A, we have f(x)=x∈A, as needed.

Next, we'll show that f is injective. Pick any x1​,x2​∈A where f(x1​)=f(x2​). We need to show that x1​=x2​. Since f(x1​)=f(x2​), we see by definition of f that x1​=x2​, as required.

Finally, we'll show that f is surjective. Consider any y∈A. We will prove that there is some x∈A where f(x)=y. Pick x=y. Then x∈A (since y∈A) and f(x)=x=y, as required. ■

Theorem: If A, B, and C are sets where ∣A∣=∣B∣ and ∣B∣=∣C∣, then ∣A∣=∣C∣.

Proof: Consider any sets A, B, and C where ∣A∣=∣B∣ and ∣B∣=∣C∣. We need to prove that ∣A∣=∣C∣. To do so, we need to show that there is a bijection from A to C.

Since ∣A∣=∣B∣, we know that there is a some bijection f:A→B. Similarly, since ∣B∣=∣C∣ we know that there is at least one bijection g:B→C.

Consider the function g∘f:A→C. Since g and f are bijections and the composition of two bijections is a bijection, we see that g∘f is a bijection from A to C. Thus ∣A∣=∣C∣, as required. ■

两个基本性质, 以后可以直接用:

  • 自反性 ∣A∣=∣A∣: 用恒等函数 f(x) = x, 显然是双射.
  • 传递性 ∣A∣=∣B∣ 且 ∣B∣=∣C∣ 推出 ∣A∣=∣C∣: 由假设得到两个双射 f、g (假设里的「存在」→ 直接引入), 它们的复合 g∘f 是 A 到 C 的双射. 用到上一讲「单射的复合是单射, 满射的复合是满射」.

还有对称性 (∣A∣=∣B∣ 推出 ∣B∣=∣A∣) 要用到双射的逆函数, 课件没有在这里讲.

原文笔误: “there is a some bijection f : A → B” 多了 a, 应为 “there is some bijection”.

Slide 48–49

Question: Why did we need to prove things about how = works? Don't we know from basic math that A=A and A=B=C→A=C are always true?

Answer: Because knowing that “from basic math” means knowing that about the equals operator = as it applies to integers and real numbers. We didn't yet have any reason to believe it works to our new definition of the = operator as it applies to cardinality!

为什么连「A 和自己一样大」都要证? 因为我们熟悉的等号性质 (自反、传递) 是关于数的等号. 基数的「=」是刚用双射重新定义的, 它是否也满足这些性质, 必须从新定义出发证明, 不能想当然.

重谈康托尔定理
Cantor's Theorem Revisited

Slide 51–52

Cantor's Theorem

  • In our very first lecture, we sketched out a proof of Cantor's theorem, which says that

    If S is a set, then ∣S∣<∣℘(S)∣.

  • Today, we finally have the tools to more formally prove that result, or more specifically, this version:

    If S is a set, then ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣.

Bijection and Cardinality

  • If we think this is true for some set S: ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣
  • Then we're saying we believe that there does not exist any bijection between S and ℘(S).
  • Let's explore one example function from S to ℘(S). (remember: we aren't expecting that this can be a bijection)

第 00 讲只给了康托尔定理 ∣S∣<∣℘(S)∣ 的直观论证. 这一讲严格证明较弱的版本 ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣ (「小于」还要定义 ≤, 课程后面才有). 按定义, ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣ 的意思是: 从 S 到 ℘(S) 不存在任何双射. 先看一个具体例子.

Slide 53–56

This is a drawing of a function f:S→℘(S), where f(x)={x}. In other words, we map each element onto a singleton set containing just itself.

Is this... Injective? Surjective? Bijective?

This function is injective, but... Not surjective. (As we expected, this f is not bijective.)

例子 f(x)={x}: 每个元素映到只含它自己的 singleton 单元素集. 它是单射 (不同元素的单元素集不同), 但不是满射: 含两个以上元素的子集、空集都不是任何元素的像. 所以不是双射.

Slide 57–59

Bijection and Cardinality

  • Ok we found one function f:S→℘(S), where f(x)={x}, and showed that this function is not bijective.
  • Question: Have we proved this? ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣
  • Why or why not?
  • Answer: No, because there could be some other function that is bijective. Remember our coins/fruit slide from earlier!

If S is a set, then ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣. What would be a good way to approach proving this?

  1. Name a specific function f:S→℘(S) that we carefully design for this purpose, and show that f is not bijective.
  2. Pick an arbitrary function f:S→℘(S), and show f is not injective.
  3. Pick an arbitrary function f:S→℘(S), and show f is not surjective.

Which approach has hope of giving us a rigorous proof?

一个函数失败不能说明问题, 理由同硬币和水果的例子. 三个方案里只有第 3 个可行:

  • 方案 1 只处理了一个函数, 原因同上.
  • 方案 2 不行, 因为确实存在单射 (就是上面的 f(x)={x}), 不能对任意 f 证明它不是单射.
  • 方案 3: 对任意函数都证明它不是满射, 就排除了所有双射.
Slide 60–62

The Roadmap

  • We're going to prove this statement: If S is a set, then ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣.
  • Here's how this will work:
    • Pick an arbitrary set S.
    • Pick an arbitrary function f:S→℘(S).
    • Show that f is not surjective.
    • Conclude that there are no bijections from S to ℘(S).
    • Conclude that ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣.

This will be tricky to pull off, because f is arbitrary, meaning we don't know what it is! Q: How can we argue f fails, when we don't know what it is??

A: Diagonalization is a VERY cool trick!! Cantor was hella genius!!

证明路线: 任取集合 S, 任取函数 f:S→℘(S), 证明 f 不是满射; 由于 f 是任意的, 所以不存在双射, 于是 ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣.

难点: f 是任意的, 我们不知道它长什么样, 怎么证明它漏掉了某个子集? 答案是对角线方法: 用 f 本身构造出一个它漏掉的子集.

Slide 63–79

For this proof, we pick an arbitrary function f:S→℘(S). We don't know what f looks like, so this drawing just has some “random” values as examples of what the f might look like.

“Flip” this set. Swap what's included and what's excluded. Which element is paired with this set?

What set is this?

Why is x1​ in this set? x1​∈/f(x1​)
Why is x3​ in this set? x3​∈/f(x3​)
Why is x4​ in this set? x4​∈/f(x4​)

Define D={x∈S∣x∈/f(x)}

和第 00 讲一样画出 f 的表, 把对角线翻转得到 {x1​,x3​,x4​,…}. 新的一步是说清这个集合是什么: 为什么 x1​ 在里面? 因为对角线第 1 格空着, 即 x1​∈/f(x1​). x3​、x4​ 同理. 所以翻转后的集合就是「不属于自己的像的元素」组成的集合:

D={x∈S∣x∈/f(x)}

这个定义不需要表格, 也不需要把 S 排成一列, 对任何集合 S 和任何 f 都有意义.

幻灯片前后不一致: 和第 00 讲相同, Slide 63–64 里 f(x2​) 写作 {x0​,x1​,x2​,x5​,…}, Slide 65 起变成 {x0​,x2​,x5​,…}. 对角线只看 x2​ 是否属于 f(x2​), 不影响论证.

Slide 80

The Diagonal Set

  • For any set S and function f:S→℘(S), we can define a set D as follows:

    D={x∈S∣x∈/f(x)}

    (“The set of all elements x where x is not an element of the set f(x).”)

  • This is a formalization of the set we found in the previous picture.
  • Using this choice of D, we can formally prove that no function f:S→℘(S) is a bijection.

diagonal set 对角集合 D: 所有满足「x 不属于集合 f(x)」的 x. 注意 f(x) 本身是一个集合 (℘(S) 的元素), 所以「x ∈ f(x)」是有意义的问题. D 是 S 的子集, 因此是 ℘(S) 的一个元素, 也就是 f 「应该」能取到的一个输出.

用一个有限的例子算一遍 D. 设 S={1,2,3}, 并取 f(1)={1,2}, f(2)=∅, f(3)={1,3}.

  • 1 属于 f(1), 所以 1 不在 D 里.
  • 2 不属于 f(2)=∅, 所以 2 在 D 里.
  • 3 属于 f(3), 所以 3 不在 D 里.

于是 D={2}. 三个像分别是 {1,2}、∅、{1,3}, 都不等于 {2}: 和 f(1) 在元素 1 上不同, 和 f(2) 在元素 2 上不同, 和 f(3) 在元素 3 上不同. 这正是「第 n 行在第 n 位上一定不同」. 换任何一个 f, 构造出的 D 都会躲开它的所有像.

Slide 81–97

Theorem: If S is a set, then ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣.

Proof: Let S be an arbitrary set. We will prove that ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣ by showing that there are no bijections from S to ℘(S). To do so, choose an arbitrary function f:S→℘(S). We will prove that f is not surjective.

Starting with f, we define the set

D={x∈S∣x∈/f(x)}.(1)

We will show that there is no y∈S such that f(y)=D. To do so, we proceed by contradiction. Suppose that there is some y∈S such that f(y)=D. By the definition of D, we know that

y∈D if and only if y∈/f(y).(2)

By assumption, f(y)=D. Combined with (2), this tells us

y∈D if and only if y∈/D.(3)

This is impossible. We have reached a contradiction, so our assumption must have been wrong. Therefore, there is no y∈S such that f(y)=D, so f is not surjective. This means that f is not a bijection, and since our choice of f was arbitrary, we conclude that there are no bijections between S and ℘(S). Thus ∣S∣=∣℘(S)∣, as required. ■

逐步看:

  1. 任取 S 和 f:S→℘(S), 目标是证 f 不是满射, 即存在 ℘(S) 中的某个元素没被取到. 这个元素就是 D.
  2. 反证: 设有 y∈S 使 f(y)=D.
  3. D 的定义对 y 也成立: y 属于 D 当且仅当 y 不属于 f(y). 这是把 D 的定义 (一个 ∀ 的性质) 套用在具体的 y 上.
  4. 把 f(y) 换成 D, 得到「y ∈ D 当且仅当 y ∉ D」. 无论 y 在不在 D 里都矛盾.
  5. 所以没有 y 的像是 D, f 不是满射, 也就不是双射. f 是任意的, 所以不存在双射.

这个「自己属于自己当且仅当自己不属于自己」的结构, 和罗素悖论、理发师悖论同源, 后面证明停机问题不可判定时还会再出现.
